title: Doubled on the h-File
setup: Your rooks are stacked on the h-file, and the black king is jammed into the corner behind three pawns.
hint: Two rooks on one file means the front one can be given away. Ask what the back one controls afterward.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxh7+}} is safe because the rook on h3 defends h7, so {{Kg8}} is forced. {{Rh8#}} then mates: the king still cannot take, f7 and g7 are its own pawns, and stepping to f8 keeps it on the rank the rook attacks.
